headline: EPS edges up sequentially
summary_short: Shenzhen Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥2.04, up 6.1% q/q from ¥1.9225; no y/y comparison is available from shard data.
summary_long: EPS of ¥2.04 rose 6.1% sequentially from ¥1.9225. No prior-year EPS is carried on the shard for this period, and no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. No edgarCik and no filing-kind sourceLink. A WebSearch surfaced third-party (MarketScreener) headlines citing an H1 2026 net-profit decline of either 33% or 5% y/y, mutually inconsistent and paywalled beyond the headline; neither figure could be verified against a primary document, so it is omitted here rather than reconciled with the shard's quarterly EPS figures.
